stem: A well child has a short history of cough, coryza and no focal chest signs. What is the best management regarding antibiotics?
explanation: Antibiotics are not indicated for an uncomplicated viral upper respiratory tract infection. Management is supportive unless features suggest bacterial infection or another diagnosis.
